paragraphs.text: DSH header to-do plugin: rotating pending tasks, urgency tinting, persistent panel
# dsh-todo

A to-do list for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one button in the session header, one floating panel
behind
it. Ships as a Cordis bundle plugin for the DSH web UI.
## Features
- **Header ticker** — the button cycles through unfinished items every 4 s and pauses while hovered

or while the panel is open. Completed items never enter the rotation.
- **Urgency tinting** — the wh

ole button is tinted by due time: overdue red, within 24 h amber,
later green, everything done neutr

al. The same colours mark each row in the panel.
- **Persistent panel** — add, edit (text and deadli

ne), tick off, delete, clear completed. Rows are
sorted by urgency, and the finished ones collapse i

nto a `Done (n)` section.
- **Quick deadlines** — `Today` / `Tomorrow` chips (18:00 today, 09:00 tom

orrow), a datetime picker,
or no deadline at all.
- **Local persistence** — items live in `localStor

age` (`dsh-todo.items.v1`), so a reload keeps them.
- **Theme-native** — every colour is a `--dsw-al

ias-*` token, so light and dark follow DSH. UI text is
English or Chinese depending on the host loca

-*` token, so light and dark follow DSH. UI text is
English or Chinese depending on the host locale.

`plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<p

ath to a local clone>`.
Restart or refresh after installing. The plugin registers no host-side servi

ces; the client half
owns all rendering.
## Mount points
| Purpose | Slot | id | order |

| Header button | `conversation.session.header.utilities` | `dsh-todo:button` | -20 |
| Floating pan
el | `shell.overlay` | `dsh-todo:panel` | 900 |
`shell.overlay` is a click-through layer, so the card opts back into pointer events explicitly.

## 中文说明
DSH 会话标题栏里的待办清单：

- **按钮轮播**：每 4 秒切换一条未完成事项，鼠标悬停或面板展开时暂停，已完成的不参与轮播。
- **紧急度着色**：逾期红、24 小时内黄、稍后绿、全部完成时中性；面板里的每一行同样着色。
-

**常驻面板**：新增、编辑（文字与截止时间）、勾选、删除、清除已完成；按紧急度排序，已完成收进
「已完成 n 项」折叠区。
- **快捷截止时间**：「今天」18:00、「明天」09:00、手选时

间，或「不限时间」。
- **本地持久化**：数据存在 `localStorage`（`dsh-todo.items.v1`），刷新不丢。
- **跟随主题**：只使用 `--dsw-alias-*`
token，中英文按宿主语言自动切换。

安装：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:OverToWind/dsh-todo`，或在 DSH 会话里用
`plugin_manager actio
n=install_bundle target=<本地仓库路径>`。
